description: This file defines data structures and methods for representing and serializing Android build modules and properties in Rust, including classes like BpModule, BpProperties, and BpValue, with functionality to write these structures in Android.bp format.

classes.name: BpModule
classes.description: Represents a build module with a type and properties, capable of serializing itself to Android.bp format.

classes.name: BpProperties
classes.description: Holds key-value pairs representing properties of a build module, with methods for manipulation and serialization.

classes.name: BpValue
classes.description: An enum representing different types of property values (Object, Bool, String, List) with serialization support.

methods.name: new
methods.description: Creates a new instance of BpModule with a specified module type.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Serializes the BpModule or BpProperties to Android.bp format.

methods.name: get_string
methods.description: Retrieves a string property value by key from BpProperties.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets a property key to a value in BpProperties.

methods.name: object
methods.description: Accesses or creates a nested BpProperties object for a given key.
